continuation_instruction.name: continuation_instruction
continuation_instruction.default: 'Continue the narrative naturally without repeating the previous text.'

prompt_preset_block_shape_check.name: prompt_preset_block_shape_check
prompt_preset_block_shape_check.value:
(
				"prompt_preset_block"."reference" = 'history'
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IS NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."name" IS NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."content" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"prompt_preset_block"."reference" = 'instruction'
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IS NOT NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IN ('system', 'user', 'assistant')
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."name" IS NOT NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."content" IS NOT NULL
			) OR (
				"prompt_preset_block"."reference" IN (
					'model-system-instruction',
					'human-identity',
					'model-identity',
					'model-scenario',
					'model-example-dialogue',
					'model-post-history-instruction'
				)
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IS NOT NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IN ('system', 'user', 'assistant')
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."name" IS NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."content" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"prompt_preset_block"."reference" = 'lore'
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IS NOT NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IN ('system', 'user', 'assistant')
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."name" IS NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."content" IS NULL
			) OR (
				"prompt_preset_block"."reference" = 'memory'
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IS NOT NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."role" IN ('system', 'user', 'assistant')
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."name" IS NULL
				AND "prompt_preset_block"."content" IS NULL
			)
